title: Quality Studio security hardening
summary: Decision-ready hardening plan for untrusted repository ingestion, review-agent and sensor isolation, credential handling, dependency advisories, result rendering, and downstream handover. Option C / S0-S6 remain decision-pending; see the implementation-state section for narrow defense-in-depth slices (F-02 prompt boundary, F-04 scan coverage and scanner-defect fix, R-08 dependency gate) landed ahead of that decision. The secrets scanner (gitleaks) now genuinely detects and blocks findings end to end -- it previously always reported a silent pass regardless of repository content.
